name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+5

- Beta 3: faster start, steadier Discord, fewer library lookups
  - Home opens as soon as AniList has loaded (at least 0.8 s, at most the old 3 s) instead of always after 3 seconds, with a short fade
  - Discord status stays connected through Control Center, notifications and the app switcher, and reconnects by itself when Discord closes the connection
  - For 10 minutes after the Stremio library loads, titles that aren't in it are trusted to be new (up to 2 fewer requests when a new show starts syncing)
  - Self Test: Discord check says why it isn't connected; sync settings show the Simkl switch
